ask: Art-direct "Cathedral Pipe Organ Resonance" — #26 of the 72 Ambo church visualizers (Uptempo Praise & Hymnal lyric visualizer, Collection II of 72; subgenre Hymnal & Pipe Organ). Premise: 3D cylindrical brass organ pipes, bay-leaf mouths, and Gothic rose window. Interactive code twin of the Hymnal Organ Gold concept plate: symmetrical ranks of cylindrical brushed-brass cathedral organ pipes with sculpted mouths and walnut casework glow in real time with the 16-band harmonic spectrum. Lighting today: Key: Warm 3500K brass pipe reflections + sapphire rose backlight. Service use: Traditional hymns, festival preludes, organ & brass anthems, Doxology. Audio mapping today: Harmonic → Illuminates individual brass organ pipes across 16 frequency ranks; Pulse → Expands warm acoustic soundwaves from the central rose window; Bass → Drives the tall outer 32-foot pedal division pipes. Palette: #0B0D18 #1E2C4F #D99B38 #FFF2CC. Keep the id, name, premise and palette; rebuild the direction: the geometry and depth planes, typography for the praise lyric band (faster lines, beat-locked emphasis, a hymnal four-part feel where the subgenre asks for it), image logic (how the Gemini concept plate it twins (/sanctuary-plates/praise-hymnal-organ-gold.jpg, blended in at plateBlend) and the procedural scene meet), texture, motion, and which audio channel drives what. Decide it — the lead's lens will drive the kit's material weave and optical pass for this one.
audience: Congregations watching a projector or LED wall from the pews, five to forty metres away, eyes on the words; and the worship leader or volunteer running Ambo live from a laptop.
feeling: Joy and momentum — a congregation on its feet; bright and celebratory, the beat felt in light and growth, never in a strobe.
constraints: Build method (fixed): a real-time Canvas 2D audio-reactive renderer in Plajah's worship visualizer kit — sanctuary background, multi-plane depth (god rays, motes, bokeh), the kit's Council optical pass (35mm light leaks, anamorphic flare, film grain, colour punch, and a tactile material weave keyed to the LEAD director's lens) and the kit's lyric / scripture typography engine. No video playback, no WebGL, no assets beyond the one concept plate.

Audio drives amplitude, colour, light, growth and glow only — never the position of the words. Envelopes are smoothed; nothing strobes or flashes (photosensitive-safe); uptempo pulses are spring-damped.

The reading band is sacred: lyrics or scripture must stay legible at 1920×1080 and 4K from the back pew, over the busiest moment of the scene. A text-safe dimming band is part of the kit; direct how the scene yields to it.

Typefaces are fixed to the kit's open-licensed set: Noto Serif (text serif), Outfit / Inter (sans), Cinzel (display), JetBrains Mono. Direct scale, case, tracking, measure and hierarchy, not new families.

Sacred imagery is used correctly and respectfully: biblical places and objects are specific and attributable, never costume; nothing denominational or branded; nothing that reads as a music video or a screensaver.
Runs at 60 fps on an integrated-GPU laptop driving a projector: favour layered gradients, cached textures and a few large shapes over particle storms.
Keep this visualizer's id, name, premise and four-colour palette. The council owns the direction, not the catalogue entry.
references: Concept plate: /sanctuary-plates/praise-hymnal-organ-gold.jpg — a Gemini art plate this visualizer was built as the interactive code twin of.
Sample lyric lines on the band: "Praise God from whom all blessings flow" / "Lift every voice with joyful sound and sing".
